_about: Repository values for gfx.py, which is byte-identical in Chaos Redux and the Agentic HOI4 Modding package. asset_tools is the folder holding convert_to_dds.py, process_report_event_image.py and their project_settings.json; shared_registry_prefix groups `.gfx` registries whose file name starts with it under `shared_<name>` on contact sheets (empty: no grouping).
